Implemented and validated the cache-only optimization on branch `codex/llama3-vllm-rmsnorm-cache`, commit `9ef99c6b04da1dbefef0420012341cd174ede863`.

Diagnosis: `unified.pre_attn.input_norm` (`rms_norm_vllm`) used the scalar `vllm_cuda` regime (`vec_size=1`, 1024-thread cap). Its Analyzer target-scope R0 was `0.0008273085225373506` GPU-s versus R5 `0.0005285150720000001`, a 1.565x ratio and `0.0002987934505373505` GPU-s gap. Higher-ratio candidates were not cache-actionable: `lm_head`'s cached alternative was slower, while attention prefill and KV append had no alternate cached backend. `pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder`

Fix: in [simulator/src/arch/llama3_dense_vllm_before.rs](simulator/src/arch/llama3_dense_vllm_before.rs:10), changed `VEC_SIZE` from 1 to 8 and `BLOCK_SIZE_LARGE_CAP` from 1024 to 256, keeping `vllm_cuda`, the 256-token threshold, and the 1024 small cap. This selects the warm vectorized RMSNorm row `(m=4096, block_size=256, vec_size=8)` without changing RMSNorm math, model-work semantics, or the CostTree. The isolated leaf fell from `38.871717` us to `17.605420` us. `pred.casev0.operationv0.kernel2.kernel-throughput`

The target-scope R0/R5 ratio improved to 1.525x; total prediction time changed from `61.007728576660156` ms to `60.9864616394043` ms. `pred.casev0.optimality-kernel-ladder` `pred.casev0.optimality-breakdown` `pred.overview`

Validation used `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=''` and the warm `profiling/profile.db`: the updated dry-run reported 0/1,442 missing specs, the timing prediction completed, the CostTree stayed at 14 leaves with only the target leaf base/config changed, and `cargo test -p simulator llama3_dense_vllm_before --lib` passed 2/2. The after result used [eval-configs/after.json](eval-configs/after.json), identical to `before.json` except for `log_dir`, so the baseline Analyzer resource remained preserved at [logs/eval_before_run/prediction.meta.json](logs/eval_before_run/prediction.meta.json) and the after result is at [logs/eval_after_run/prediction.meta.json](logs/eval_after_run/prediction.meta.json). `cargo fmt --all -- --check` could not run because `cargo-fmt` is not installed.
